Therefore, the question of generalizing Theorem 36 by adding equality remains open. 5 Toy Example: a Notification System Here, a simple example of a notification system in a ring is presented to illustrate the expressiveness of the fragment4 . The structure of the network is defined by a predicate succ relating a node to its successor, and a formula Ring specifying that succ forms a ring topology. The formula Ring is specified as proposed in [15], with the use of a ternary predicate, in pure FO (without transitive closure). Each node x of the ring may be aware (notified(x)) of a certain piece of information, or not. Any node that has been notified may notify its successor (by sending a message), and other nodes do not change during this operation.
